content.value_statement: Smart contracts fail when common vulnerabilities are missed before deployment. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through focused Solidity security reviews.
actual_capabilities: Explains reentrancy risks and applies checks-effects-interactions or ReentrancyGuard patterns.
Reviews overflow, underflow, access control, input validation, and front-running concerns.
Suggests secure payment patterns, emergency stops, and audit documentation practices.
Identifies Solidity gas optimization options that do not weaken security.
Outlines Hardhat security test ideas for reentrancy, overflow, and access control.
limitations: Does not replace professional smart contract audits or formal verification.
Does not execute tools such as Slither, Mythril, Echidna, or Manticore by itself.
Needs contract source, compiler version, and threat model for precise guidance.
Examples may need adjustment for specific Solidity and OpenZeppelin versions.

use_cases.title: Review DeFi Contract Changes
use_cases.description: Check withdrawal, swap, and payment flows before testnet or mainnet deployment.

use_cases.title: Prepare Pre-Audit Notes
use_cases.description: Build a checklist of roles, external calls, invariants, and known risk areas.

use_cases.title: Set Team Security Standards
use_cases.description: Create practical guidance for safe Solidity patterns and required tests.

prompt_templates.title: Check Basic Risks
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Solidity contract for reentrancy, overflow, access control, and input validation. Explain each issue in plain language and suggest safer patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Harden Payment Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of withdrawals or payouts
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this withdrawal or payout flow. Apply checks-effects-interactions, pull over push, and failure handling. List exact changes and tests to add.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Audit Checklist
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced preparation for an external audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a pre-audit checklist for this protocol. Include threat assumptions, privileged roles, external calls, upgrade paths, and test coverage gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Model DeFi Attack Paths
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert review of a protocol design
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this DeFi design for front-running, slippage, oracle, reentrancy, and access-control risks. Rank findings by exploitability and propose mitigations.

output_examples.input: Review a token withdrawal function before deployment.
output: Flags external calls that happen before state updates.
Adds tests for repeated withdrawals and failed transfers.

output_examples.input: Prepare audit notes for a DeFi swap contract.
output: Lists roles, external dependencies, and privileged functions.
Suggests invariants and scenario tests for the audit package.

output_examples.input: Improve a contract for safer production deployment.
output: Prioritizes access control, input validation, and emergency stop behavior.
Separates critical fixes from optional gas improvements.
Explains verification steps for each recommendation.

best_practices: Provide contract source, compiler version, dependencies, and deployment chain.
Ask for severity ranking, exploit scenarios, and concrete verification steps.
Pair every mitigation with tests, invariants, or audit notes.
anti_patterns: Requesting final approval without full source and threat assumptions.
Copying example patterns without adapting roles, invariants, and dependencies.
Prioritizing gas optimization over exploit resistance and clear access control.

faq.question: Can this skill audit production smart contracts?
faq.answer: It can support review and preparation, but it does not replace a professional audit.

faq.question: Which vulnerabilities does it focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on reentrancy, overflow, access control, input validation, front-running, and unsafe external calls.

faq.question: Can it run security tools automatically?
faq.answer: No. It can recommend tools and tests, but execution depends on the host environment.

faq.question: Does it support DeFi protocols?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for swaps, payments, slippage, front-running, and protocol audit preparation.

faq.question: What input gives the best results?
faq.answer: Provide source code, dependencies, compiler version, deployment target, roles, and known assumptions.

faq.question: Can it help after an audit?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help interpret findings, plan fixes, and define regression tests.
